dockerfile.description: Golden base images use MOVING tags (daily rebuild) — leave them to golden-image, don't pin the Dockerfile FROM lines.

argocd.description: Chart versions live in config/thirdparty/*.yaml (the ApplicationSet templates them), not in the Application CR — so the argocd manager has nothing to read.

customManagers.description: In-house app image tags in the DEV env config (annotated). Prod pins by digest and is promoted by a human, so it carries no annotation and is left alone.
Third-party Helm chart version in config/thirdparty/*.yaml.

packageRules.description: In-house app images (dev env config). Auto-bump; prod is promoted by digest (docs/PROMOTION.md).
